headline: IC RegFin Legal advises Oister Global on investment in Bombay Shaving Company
sum: Oister Global has invested in Visage Lines Personal Care Private Limited, dba Bombay Shaving Company. IC RegFin Legal Partners advised Oister Global on this investment.
detail: Oister Global has invested in Visage Lines Personal Care Private Limited, dba Bombay Shaving Company. IC RegFin Legal Partners advised Oister Global on this investment. The transaction was led by Sidharth Dhody (Partner), along with Abhishek Singh (Senior Associate). Bombay Shaving Company Founded in 2015, Bombay Shaving Company offers a wide range of grooming, shaving, skincare and personal care products, combining contemporary product formulations with accessible pricing and a strong digital-first distribution model.
